title: Abbas kahan ho
body:
kehte thay shahe deen mere abbas kahan ho
abbas kahan ho abbas kahan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
tanha hoon khada dashte bala mein baradar
dekho zara aa kar dekho zara aa kar
<<DIVIDER>>
paala tha jinhe naazon se sote hai kahan wo
abbas kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
dikhta nahi ab aankhon se har soo hai andhera
dam rukta hai mera dam rukta hai mera
deta hai sadayein ali akbar mera mujhko
abbas kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene mein jawan laal ke barchi ki ani hai
tharraati zameen hai tharraati zameen hai
uljha hua barchi mein na akbar ka jigar ho
abbas kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
haathon pe ugalta hai lahoo asghare baysheer
gardan pe laga teer gardan pe laga teer
kya keh ke tasalli doon mai dar pe khadi maa ko
abbas kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
nanhi si lehad mein ali asghar ko lita kar
mitti pe sula kar mitti pe sula kar
uth'ta hoon kabhi girta hoon thaame huwe dil ko
abbas kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
cheenenge sakina ke gohar ab ye sitamgar
qasim hai na akbar qasim hai na akbar
laashe pe mere aake pukaregi wo tum ko
abbas kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
chalti rahi gardan pe churi dekh rahi thi
zainab ne sada di zainab ne sada di
sookha hai gala bhai ka pani to pila do
abbas kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
chalti thi siyaah aandhiyan khoon bikhra tha har soo
jab khol ke gaysu jab khol ke gaysu
ek laashe bureeda pe ye maa kehti thi ro ro
abbas kahan ho...
author: Ali Rizvi Sachey
